annotations.title: Scan Document for Malware & Prompt Injection

description: Scan a PDF, Office document (DOC/DOCX/XLS/XLSX/PPT/PPTX/RTF/OneNote), email, archive, URL, or extracted text in under 100ms for embedded malware exploits, macros, CVEs, and hidden AI/RAG prompt-injection payloads (3 Tr invisible PDF text, zero-point fonts, hidden OOXML vanish runs, spoofed tool-call tags, and markdown exfiltration beacons) with zero file retention. IMPORTANT: Pass 'text_content' (raw/extracted text, Markdown, or HTML), 'content_base64' (base64 file bytes or data URI), or 'url' (public https:// link). Do not pass container-local '/mnt/user-data' file paths directly.

api_key.description: Optional MalwareTracker API key (mt_live_...) if not authenticated via OAuth or headers.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded bytes (or data:...;base64, URI) of the document to inspect.

password.description: Optional password for decrypting protected Office documents.

text_content.description: Raw UTF-8 text, extracted document text, Markdown, or HTML to inspect.

url.description: Public https:// URL to download and scan the document from.

name: quicksand_scan_document
title: Scan Document for Malware & Prompt Injection
